title: The Ordinance of the Red Heifer — parah adumah (פרה אדמה), with Red Cow Steak House cushion
summary: Heading 'The Ordinance of the Red Heifer' with the Hebrew phrase parah adumah (פרה אדמה), 'Red Heifer', colour-matched in red and black. Below is a photo of a cushion printed with a red butcher's-cut cow and the words RED COW STEAK HOUSE, a visual play on 'red cow'.

text.text: The Ordinance of the Red Heifer

pictures.description: A cream-coloured woven cushion leaning on a couch, printed with a red silhouette of a cow divided into butcher's cuts and the words RED COW above the smaller words STEAK HOUSE. A small red-and-white BigLife logo sits in the top-left corner of the photo.
pictures.text_in_picture: RED COW STEAK HOUSE; BigLife (logo in corner)
